method: Chromium in-app browser, 1280x720 drawing buffer, DPR 1, antialiasing enabled, unchanged shadow resolution. Each synthetic rendering run warms 45 frames then samples 120 frames. Same 180 m terrain seed and 100 stationary unit groups; no AI/simulation in these benchmarks. Baseline is the graphics source snapshot at the start of the performance pass, not git HEAD.

verified: vehicle move command and changed position
liveCheck.note: Observed live FPS varied from 24 to 38 with combat state. This is a runtime smoke check, not a controlled before/after live combat benchmark or a 60 FPS guarantee.

validation: Production Vite build passed (existing large chunk warning)
35 faction/vehicle combinations retain triangle/position coverage, articulated anchors, muzzle origins and deformable wreck parts; 433 fewer mesh submissions across the matrix
Shared resource ownership, private clones, instance buffer disposal, late previous-battle cleanup, theatre cache eviction, same-map canvas reuse and bounded idle scheduling passed
All rural vegetation seeds preserve random draw counts; opaque finite geometry and plant triangle budgets verified
Tank rider and truck system checks passed through Vite SSR
4,194,304 terrain noise sample values unchanged by lattice caching
limitations: Realism changes intentionally reshape foliage and mute albedo/lighting. Grass gains two bends per blade (7 to 21 triangles per clump); trees and bushes retain their triangle budgets. FPS varies by device, browser, resolution and combat load. Berlin and the remaining maps were not performance-benchmarked in this pass.
